postcard.en: I collected ten postcards from different cities.
postcard.cn: 我收集了十张不同城市的明信片。

send.en: I sent a long letter to my grandma last week.
send.cn: 上周我给奶奶寄了一封长信。

write.en: Don't forget to write the name and address clearly.
write.cn: 别忘把名字地址写清楚。

address.en: Please write your home address on this card.
address.cn: 请把家庭地址写在这张卡片上。

stamp.en: I collect stamps from many different countries.
stamp.cn: 我收集很多国家的邮票。

miss.en: I really miss my hometown when I'm far away.
miss.cn: 远在他乡时我特别想念家乡。

weather.en: The weather here changes every few hours.
weather.cn: 这里的天气几小时就变一次。

wish.en: Send my warmest wishes to everyone at home.
wish.cn: 请把我最真挚的祝福带给家里每个人。
